The Club

Cape Town's Finest Revue Bar

Where Every Night is Extraordinary

At Mavericks, the entertainment options are endless. From over 100 professional dancers across multiple stages, to fine dining until 4am, expertly crafted cocktails and five distinct spaces — each with its own character — there is a place for every taste, every occasion.

Dress code is your choice. Only our dancers are barefoot.

01 — Signature

The Main Floor

The ultimate playground. The centrepiece of Mavericks — a dramatic stage surrounded by intimate seating, pole-dancers, aerial performers and over 100 dancers delivering unforgettable experiences. The full dining menu is available at your table, alongside our complete drinks selection.

Cover Charge R 100
Kitchen Open until 4am
Dancers 100+ nightly
View Pricing →
02 — VIP

VIP Mezzanine

Elevated above the Main Floor, the VIP Mezzanine offers a panoramic view of the stage below. An intimate setting with dedicated table service, reserved seating and the full Mavericks experience from an exclusive vantage point.

Entry from R 500  ·  R 400 from inside
Cover charge details →
03 — VIP

Platinum Lounge

In the Platinum VIP Lounge, guests are attended by a select group of personal hostesses in private booths adorned with lavish red velvet curtains. An atmosphere of intimate luxury — elevated service, elevated experience.

Entry from R 500  ·  R 400 from inside
Cover charge details →
04 — VIP Elite

Empire Lounge

Evoking the elegance of a 1920s Gentlemen's Club, the Empire Lounge is designed for distinction. A private VIP space with dedicated service, bottle selection, shisha and the option of a private dance — available for exclusive group bookings.

Entry from R 500  ·  Bookable for private functions
Book the Empire Experience → Cover charge details →
05 — VVIP Elite

The Library

The pinnacle of the Mavericks experience. An intimate sanctuary of absolute class and refinement — with its own private entrance, dedicated librarian and hostesses, and complete privacy. The Library is for those who demand the very best.

Entry R 1 000  ·  Bookable for private functions
Book the Library Experience →

The Cigar Lounge

Cigar & Hookah Lounge

Situated on the Mezzanine floor, the Cigar Lounge houses our Humidor — a curated selection of the world's finest Cuban cigars. Pair your cigar with a premium spirit or settle into a Turkish Hookah as the night unfolds around you.
